messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['Our system detected an error in your account, we strongly advise you update your account to avoid account Suspension or Deactivation.', 'Your access to Online Services has been suspended.', 'Your online banking password was entered incorrectly more than 3 times.', 'All occupants of the vehicle unfortunately lost their lives.', 'Access suspended.', 'Status: WAITING CONFIRMATION', 'Your access to online banking has been suspended temporary for security reasons by HSBC, N. A', 'Your contact information has been updated', 'We have encountered difficulty verifying your account information.', 'For your protection Internet Banking access to your account(s) has been blocked.', 'You have 4 unread message(s)...', 'YOUR WINNING PRIZE OF TWO HUNDRED AND FIFTYTHOUSAND GREAT BRITISH POUNDS (GBP-250,000.00) HAS BEEN DEPOSITED IN\xa0A BANK HERE FOR SECURITY REASONS', 'For your protection, please for...', 'Our Banks Automated IP security section has noticed unusual activity on your account.', 'GMAC Bank has recently changed its name to be Ally bank, and these days we introduce a new version of banking software.', 'Your email (howiem@bigfoot.com) is almost full.', 'Thanks for your order, gradwell@highwayman.com', 'This email confirms that you have added the following address to your account: Flat 29 468 Scrapbook Road South Yorkshire, S13 7\xa0GB United Kingdom', 'We would like to notify you that NatWest bank carries out customer data verification procedure that is compulsory for all NatWest bank customers.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
